name: Aegis Nagablade
description: Hold the shaft along a fixed line at the chest so any arc can start from a sealed guard.

name: Gustnagi
description: Let the blade hang from a loose upper grip and slice down across the foe's lead arm.

name: Piercing Nagaheel
description: Jab the point out from a choked grip at the gap beneath the foe's raised elbow.

name: Hardened Ishizuki
description: Beat the incoming weapon outward with the flat of the shaft and open the foe's line.

name: Gustishi
description: Roll backward off the heel of one foot to the toe of the other while the guard stays up.

name: Scything Nagashaft
description: Join two sweeps at the turn of the hips so the second arc leaves before the first has ended.

name: Mantled Sayacap
description: Catch an attacking weapon on the haft and turn it with a pulse of qi so it spins away.

name: Tempered Uchiotoshi
description: Heave the blade overhead and hew down with a thick load of qi to split a raised guard.

name: Mawashi Onslaught
description: Chain three unbroken sweeps from high to low with qi renewed at each turn so every arc follows the last.

name: Scorching Blaze Nagi
description: Gather qi into the whole stance then loose it in one broad reaping arc that cuts every foe within reach.

name: Thorn Bladecurve
description: Settle low with the shaft drawn back along the flank so the weight and the blade gather behind the hips.

name: Iron Tsubaring
description: Slice upward from the crouch and catch the foe's front thigh before he sees the stroke begin.

name: Needling Nagatip
description: Drive the point straight out from the rear hip with the whole hindside weight behind the shaft.

name: Gust Habakiring
description: Rest the shaft along the lead shoulder so a descending cut slides off and away from the neck.

name: Ravaging Mawashi
description: Draw the blade back through a slow turn while qi builds in the shaft then whip it forward.

name: Rumbleharai
description: Slam the whole shaft sideways into the foe's guard with all the stored weight and qi.

name: Might Sayacap
description: Step through the foe's line mid-gather so the loaded blade ends up on his open side.

name: Blazenaga
description: Hold the gathered qi until the foe closes then release it in one heavy sweep from hip to shoulder.

name: Granite Kake
description: Unleash the stored field outward along a flat sweep so every foe near the wielder is cut.

name: Ironnaga
description: Stand with the blade low and the shaft angled out so a neighbor on either side stays covered.

name: Blazesune
description: Cut on each step as the line advances so the blade rises and falls with the beat of boots.

name: Rupturing Kake
description: Poke the point low into the gap between a shield rim and the ground to catch the foot.

name: Gustnaga
description: Wheel the blade in a half circle to wave a lunging spear past the line mate's shoulder.

name: Granite Sukui
description: Sweep at knee height through the front rank so that men in the file tangle and fall.

name: Surging Tsubaring
description: Surge forward with light qi in the legs to cover several paces ahead of the line.

name: Cleaving Harai
description: Throw one long stroke from the rear heel to cut through spear shafts and the arms that hold them.

name: Aegissune
description: Plant the butt cap and brace the shaft against the shoulder so a charge breaks on the blade.

name: Enduring Nagablade
description: Stand with the feet wide and the shaft held level at the waist to watch every side.

name: Splitting Nagaheel
description: Swing the edge in a long flat line that crosses the whole front of the stance.

name: Kaketorment
description: Thrust along the one clear lane between two foes with the point reaching the farther man.

name: Resilient Ishizukibase
description: Circle the shaft around the head and sides to turn aside blows from several directions.

name: Nagipounce
description: Take one long stride along a curved path so the blade is already pointed at the next foe.

name: Toxinsukui
description: Tap the butt cap on the ground and the foe's blade in turn to mark and spoil his count.

name: Iron Habakiring
description: Surge qi along the shaft and sweep the open space ahead to push every close foe back.

name: Tempered Nagatip
description: Step back along a curve and cut behind the retreating line at the foe who gives chase.

name: Charter Ishizukibase
description: Raise the shaft overhead and spread qi along its length to cover the head against a volley of blows.

name: Paralyzing Harai
description: Loop the blade round two crossed spears and lock them together against the ground.

name: Dismantling Uchiotoshi
description: Cast a great horizontal arc of qi-driven edge that reaps the ground around the wielder in a full turn.

name: Sanguine Sukui
description: Keep the blade moving in a continuous circle around the body with qi refreshed at each pass.

name: Hoarfrost Nagashaft
description: Hold the blade so one arc of the shaft guards high while its twin arc guards low.

name: Granite Ishizukibase
description: Open with two quick cuts from the same turn of the wrists that land on opposite sides.

name: Tearing Nagi
description: Answer an outward arc with an inward slice that crosses its path and cuts the wrist.

name: Splitting Mawashi
description: Thrust once along the shaft then once along the rebound so the point strikes twice.

name: Chime Bladecurve
description: Knock aside two blows in turn with the upper and lower halves of the shaft.

name: Torrent Nagashaft
description: Glide both feet in turn on two parallel lines so the body never crosses its own track.

name: Gust Tsubaring
description: Swing one sweep and mirror it on the opposite side a breath later with a fresh pulse of qi.

name: Thornsune
description: Step beside the foe and cross the shaft over his weapon so the two are paired and locked.

name: Ishitorment
description: Add a full surge of qi only to the second of two arcs so the first draws the guard.

name: Granite Ishizuki
description: Cut two crescents at once from opposite shoulders so they meet at the foe's centre.

name: Thorn Nagatip
description: Cross two streams of qi along the shaft and clamp the foe's weapon between them without strain.

name: Facetsune
description: Perch on the rear foot with the shaft slanted forward like a hawk's wing over the lead shoulder.

name: Transfixing Habakiring
description: Drop from a raised guard in a steep diagonal cut like a hawk stooping on its prey.

name: Raging Nagaheel
description: Dart the point out and back like a talon snatching at the foe's eye line.

name: Hardened Nagablade
description: Beat the shaft out and in like a wing to sweep two attacks clear of the chest.

name: Nagileap
description: Hover on the balls of both feet and shift a half pace left or right with the blade steady.

name: Rumble Bladecurve
description: Swoop low across the foe's front with light qi in the edge then lift the blade away.

name: Staggering Sayacap
description: Hook the blade tip into the foe's sleeve or belt and hold him in place for the next pass.

name: Aegis Nagatip
description: Spread qi along both ends of the shaft like two wings and let them shield the sides.

name: Grinding Kake
description: Leap with a burst of qi and bring the blade down from above in one heavy diving cut.

name: Lambasting Sukui Assault
description: Spread the arms like wings and cast a wide pale sweep of qi-edge that cuts all within reach.

name: Hoarfrost Habakiring
description: Stand with the body turned slightly aside and the shaft following the curve of the shoulder line.

name: Tempered Ishizuki
description: Slice along the foe's guard in one smooth line that follows the shape of his posture.

name: Transfixing Sayacap
description: Slide the point forward along the foe's own blade as water finds the lowest channel.

name: Torrent Ishizuki
description: Turn the shaft in a small whirl against the blow so the force circles round and is spent.

name: Sukui Onslaught
description: Take the inside of the foe's turn and sweep across the side he cannot cover.

name: Chime Nagi
description: Drag the shaft low along the ground to catch the foe's ankle and pull his step off line.

name: Granite Mawashi
description: Wind through three short curving steps around the foe so each leaves him facing the wrong way.

name: Nagashaft Onslaught
description: Pile qi up behind the blade like a flood crest then let it break in one great arc.

name: Quelling Ishizukibase
description: Spin the shaft in a tightening whirl that draws the foe's weapon in and holds it at the centre.

name: Bladecurve Plating
description: Hold the shaft in a shallow bowl shape before the body so blows roll to the rim and off.

name: Harrowing Kake
description: Sweep the edge across a broad dish-shaped arc that passes low in the middle.

name: Ishibarrage
description: Thrust along the top edge of the foe's shield where the rim meets the wrist.

name: Unshaken Nagablade
description: Tilt the shaft so a falling blow runs down it and drips off the butt cap.

name: Siltsune
description: Step down in short level stages like terraces so the blade never dips as the ground falls.

name: Toxin Nagaheel
description: Tap the foe's blade aside the way a reed bows to a passing current and springs back.

name: Mightnagi
description: Fill the blade with qi in three short pulses and cut at the third as the arc crests.

name: Gust Sayacap
description: Turn the shaft between two guards in a single motion and pass a blow from one to the other.

name: Fastening Ishizukibase
description: Hold the foe's weapon in a still pool of qi along the shaft until his arm tires.

name: Haraibarrage
description: Crouch and scythe the edge across the ankle line so the cut passes beneath every guard.

name: Nagithrash
description: Cast a broad bright arc that mirrors the shape of the sky and reaps all in its span.

name: Uchiotoshi Torment
description: Let stored qi spill over the rim of the blade in one heavy stroke that breaks the foe's guard.

name: Adamant Tsubaring
description: Fix the blade tip on one bearing toward the foe and hold the shaft true on that line.

name: Scorching Nagatip
description: Cut into the wind with the edge leading so the draft itself presses the blade home.

name: Ravaging Harai
description: Lean into the thrust as if walking into a strong headwind and drive the point through.

name: Murk Nagashaft
description: Turn the shaft sideways like a plank in a crosswind to shove a blow off its bearing.

name: Siltharai
description: Step along an imaginary cliff line with short sure paces that keep the body square.

name: Harai Onslaught
description: Sweep upward from the low guard and let qi lift the edge as a gust lifts a hawk.

name: Aegisnaga
description: Keep the shaft still in a guard held by sworn will and a steady thread of qi.

name: Gustharai
description: Take the foe's own bearing as the line of entry and cut along it with a heavy pulse of qi.

name: Haraithrash
description: Feed the sweep with the qi of a hard gale so the edge cuts wide and fast through the guard.

name: Ponderous Uchiotoshi
description: Hold the bearing against the foe's weapon until the shaft locks it and he cannot turn.

name: Mantled Ishizuki
description: Stand with the toes to the line and the shaft slanted outward to keep the open side covered.

name: Rumble Habakiring
description: Raise the blade into the open air above and drop it in a long diagonal across the foe.

name: Transfixing Kake
description: Thrust the point at the foe's lead foot to drive him back toward the drop behind him.

name: Equipoise Nagablade
description: Turn with the wind at the moment of contact and let the foe's force carry past the hip.

name: Tempered Nagi
description: Burst out with a gust of qi on the sweep so the foe's stance is shoved aside.

name: Bladecurve Cloak
description: Spin the haft in a ring that guards all round since nothing stands at the wielder's back.

name: Sukuitorment
description: Swing a reaping stroke along the edge of the plateau that hurls the foe off his footing.

name: Daybreak Nagaheel
description: Cast the cutting arc out across the open ground so it covers the whole plateau front.

name: Charter Sayacap
description: Speak the oath under the breath and settle into a stance that is not given up.

name: Might Sukui
description: Draw the edge across the foe's guard with a single deliberate pull of the shaft.

name: Ishithrash
description: Drive the point along the straight line of the vow without a waver or a feint.

name: Nagashaft Fastness
description: Voice the vow aloud as the shaft meets the blow and turns it from the body.

name: Might Tsubaring
description: Step forward openly to face the foe as a witness of the oath would stand.

name: Mawashi Cloak
description: Tap the shaft on the foe's guard to mark the moment the oath is made binding.

name: Sanguine Ishizukibase
description: Sweep the long edge across the foe with qi that rises from the will behind the oath.

name: Immovable Bladecurve
description: Brace the shaft against a heavy blow and let qi hold it firm as a kept word holds.

name: Kake Thrash
description: Cut hard through a guard whose owner has turned from his word and left his side open.

name: Slagnaga
description: Hold the oath in mind through a long cast and reap a wide arc once the vow is complete.

name: Sukui Barrage
description: Cut one unbroken line from shoulder to hip that does not turn aside for any guard.

name: Staunch Habakiring
description: Hold the shaft on the heading of the wind and keep the guard from swinging off it.

name: Kakebarrage
description: Cut on the heading the wind blows so the edge picks up speed down the whole line.

name: Hollownaga
description: Hold the bearing unchanged through the thrust so the point arrives exactly where aimed.

name: Murk Ishizuki
description: Veer the haft a few degrees at the last moment and let the blow slip past.

name: Iron Uchiotoshi
description: Sweep with a force like a gale and carry qi out along the edge to the very tip.

name: Blazeishi
description: Shift the bearing by a step and cut across the line the foe had thought safe.

name: Chime Nagablade
description: Hold the haft loosely and feel the wind and the foe's motion together through the wood.

name: Dismantling Nagi
description: Call a wind of qi into the long curved edge and reap every foe inside the arc.

name: Sanguine Harai
description: Hold the one heading both wind and foe agree on and cut along it with the full force of the gale.
